body.name: calibrated safe DML interval
body.construction: Using the nonempty \(b_n(\alpha/4)\)-block partition in \(\operatorname{MOM}_{\alpha/4}\), set \(\widetilde\theta_D=\operatorname{MOM}_{\alpha/4}(\{(Y_{D,i}-\widehat q(X_{D,i}))(T_{D,i}-\widehat g(X_{D,i}))\}_{i=1}^n)\) and \(I_D=[\widetilde\theta_D-a_D,\widetilde\theta_D+a_D]\), where \(a_D=\varepsilon_{g,n}\varepsilon_{q,n}+\rho_n(\alpha/4)\).
